title: the Glass Steppe Rising Revisited
author: T. M. Hartwell
blurb: Felix Kavanagh, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
